expectations.text: Ranks the remediation options by value recovered per unit of effort and relationship capital spent, not by the nominal dollar amount at stake
expectations.evidence: The answer works a fixed ladder (correct before release → offset → absorb → fix-it-forward → direct recovery) and eliminates rungs on structural/eligibility grounds — platform terms barring clawback, no finance co-signer, churned partner with zero balance — not on any cost/benefit weighing. There is no assessment of effort expended per dollar recovered (e.g. chasing $148.80 vs $3,110 is never compared on collection cost) and no mention of relationship capital at all: no discussion of affiliate goodwill, the reputational cost of pursuing a partner, or when pursuit is not worth the friction.
